facts.text: The opera was first performed at La Fenice in Venice on 3 February 1823.
facts.evidence: The opera was first performed at La Fenice in Venice on 3 February 1823.

facts.text: The libretto by Gaetano Rossi is based on Voltaire's tragedy Semiramis, which in turn was based on the legend of Semiramis of Assyria.
